headline: Anderson's 'Fun Uncle' Label for Brady Spells Trouble
writeup: Buffalo Bills training camp is buzzing with optimism and intrigue as new head coach Joe Brady begins his era in Buffalo, with GM Brandon Beane confirming multiple roster moves including the signings of CB D.J. Miller Jr. and wide receiver Dante Pettis, while releasing safety Wande Owens. On the field, the Josh Allen–DJ Moore connection has been the talk of camp, with the veteran receiver flashing early chemistry with Allen and generating significant hype around the Bills' revamped wide receiver room. Defensively, new addition C.J. Gardner-Johnson is bringing his trademark edge and guarantee of a Super Bowl title, while Jim Leonhard's football IQ is already making an impression — with Bradley Chubb noting Leonhard's intelligence is 'bleeding into' the defense and Ian Rapoport adding to the growing hype around the coordinator. Kicker Tyler Bass says he's feeling like himself again, left guard competition is heating up between veterans and young players, and injury updates on Dorian Williams and Michael Hoecht loom as concerns, while the Bills also keep an eye on potential additions like Vita Vea as the new Highmark Stadium era dawns with legend Jim Kelly among those excited for the fresh chapter.
